entities.name: Metronome
entities.description: The codename for a three-year story arc from Wilds of Eldraine through Reality Fracture, centered on Jace Beleren's attempt to fix the Multiverse.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker whose attempt to fix the Multiverse is the center of Metronome.

entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: A character introduced in the Omenpath Arc who travels the Multiverse seeking his father Oko.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A planeswalker who travels the Multiverse with Jace and Loot.

entities.name: Loot
entities.description: A companion who travels with Jace and Vraska.

entities.name: Omenpaths
entities.description: Pathways between planes that emerged after the New Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Meditation Realm
entities.description: Where Jace attempts to enact his plan.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion whose consequences the Omenpath Arc deals with.

entities.name: Desparkening
entities.description: A consequence of the New Phyrexian Invasion.

events.summary: The Omenpath Arc introduces Kellan, who travels the Multiverse through Omenpaths to find his father Oko.
events.quote: This arc introduces Kellan , who travels the Multiverse via Omenpaths in search of his father Oko .

events.summary: Dragonstorms on Tarkir unleash dragons on other planes through Omenpaths.
events.quote: Dragonstorms run wild on the plane of Tarkir , unleashing dragons on other planes through Omenpaths.

events.summary: Jace apparently dies enacting his plan in the Meditation Realm.
events.quote: The arc concludes with Jace's apparent death as he attempts to enact his plan in the Meditation Realm .
